summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. filed a Form 6-K incorporating a Notice and Management Information Circular for its Special and Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for May 13, 2026. The circular covers routine items: presentation of financial statements, election of directors, appointment of external auditor, and approval of private placements and warrant amendments. This is a standard proxy solicitation for an annual meeting without any special-situation event such as a takeover, activist campaign, or restructuring. No deal terms are applicable.
